sentences.text: Viva Jets Oy is a portfolio company registered on 2018-12-28 under the industry code 30120, building of pleasure and sporting boats.
The register shows five share issues, the latest on 2026-08-17, and first sales and a first hire on 2019-01-02.
Funding on record is a round dated 2025-07-18 and three Business Finland decisions, the largest EUR 167 400 for 2024.
A product launch is dated 2024-02-16, an exhibitor or demo entry is dated 2025-09-30, and a first customer or pilot record dated 2026-04-30 is at low confidence.
On the radar's rules technology, business and investment readiness are all level 4.
For the fund the memo says watchlist because investment readiness is Low and no decision row matches, so the pilot record should be checked at its source.
